dogecoin.text: Please take a physical @dogecoin with you! :D #ToTheMoon

What a nice episode. Got this nostalgic feeling of fun and weirdness of cryptocurrency space at the time I got into it (late 2013). Dogecoin sponsoring the Jamaican bobsled team to go to Sochi Olympics - I still giggle remembering that!
Let's admit, Bitcoin tech with years of deliverate efforts to make it as scalable and private as possible, given many constraints, cannot compete on going vertical with Dogecoin.
